about.zh:
秘书部是学联的坚实后盾
在活动准备、执行、
信息传递和部门协调交流中有我们的身影
我们既是学联对外的窗口，也是内部沟通的桥梁，更是每场活动的幕后支柱！
about.en: The Secretariat supports MCSA through event preparation and delivery, information sharing and coordination between departments. We are a point of contact for the wider community, a bridge for internal communication and a team working behind every event.

大家好，我是Hugo，目前在读Business 和 IT 双专业。这学期担任秘书部信息组部长，我相信我们在MCSA中相遇是注定的。
缘起缘灭，缘聚缘散，乃众生法相。与君相逢，亦是自然。愿与君共行世间路，愿诸君身心清静，福寿康宁。福生无量天尊！
quote.en:
Hello everyone, I’m Hugo, studying Business and IT. This semester I lead the Secretariat’s Information Technology team, and I believe we were destined to meet at MCSA.
Connections arise and fade; people come together and part—this is the nature of life. Our meeting is part of that natural course. May we walk this world together, and may you enjoy peace of mind, good fortune, health and longevity. Blessings of the Boundless Celestial Worthy!

tagline.en: At the heart of the event

text.zh:
我们要做的：
整理当天需要的主持或管理流程

参加活动彩排or会议：
确认设备，人员安排，确保一切顺利进行

正式进入活动后：
担任主持、记分员、裁判员等角色

活动结束后：
协助总结活动情况，收集反馈，
为下次活动做更好优化
text.en:
Before the event, prepare the hosting and management schedule.

Attend rehearsals or meetings to confirm equipment and staffing, helping everything run smoothly.

During the event, take on roles such as host, scorekeeper or referee.

Afterwards, help review the event and collect feedback to improve the next one.

keywords.zh: 主持｜场控｜活动管理｜现场调度｜沟通力
keywords.en: Hosting · Floor management · Event coordination · Communication

text.zh:
我们要做的：
为新生答疑解惑、传递福利资讯，
搭建高效沟通桥梁，维护社群良好秩序

日常运营服务中：
用心对接沟通、细心统筹安排，
跟进活动全流程细节与关键注意事项

活动筹备期间：
统筹物资采购、场地协调与现场布置，
完成签到统计与人员安排
text.en:
Answer new students’ questions, share useful benefits and information, support clear communication and maintain a welcoming community.

Coordinate day-to-day communication and arrangements, following the details and key requirements throughout an event.

During preparation, organise supplies, venues and setup, and coordinate check-in records and staffing.

keywords.zh: 小助手运营｜内部管理｜细心与温暖｜沟通桥梁
keywords.en: Assistant accounts · Internal coordination · Care · Communication

duties.zh: 担任运营小助手，负责发布组织内部活动资讯，统筹新生及新干事的沟通对接、联络协调等工作，保障组织信息高效传递。
duties.en: Manage assistant accounts, share internal event information and coordinate communication with new students and members so information reaches the right people.

duties.zh: 协助组织开展大型活动，承担现场布置、人员签到等执行保障工作，确保活动有序落地、顺利开展。
duties.en: Support large events through venue setup, check-in and practical delivery tasks.

requirements.zh: 有耐心、有热情愿意承担工作，0经验也OK！
requirements.en: Patient, enthusiastic and willing to help—no previous experience required!

requirements.zh: 具备良好服务意识与同理心，耐心细致、善于倾听
requirements.en: Service-minded and empathetic, with patience, attention to detail and good listening skills

requirements.zh: 情绪稳定、能以积极心态处理各类新生问题
requirements.en: Calm and positive when responding to new students’ questions

requirements.zh: 责任心强、沟通得体，具备良好团队协作精神
requirements.en: Responsible, considerate in communication and a strong team player

text.zh:
我们要做的：
负责MCSA线上平台搭建、开发与长期运维，
更新活动资讯，完善实用功能，
为同学们提供便捷高效的线上服务

日常运营服务中：
持续维护官网、小程序稳定运行，
定期迭代优化平台功能，
及时处理技术问题，持续优化使用体验

技术支持保障上：
负责官网与小程序搭建开发、
日常运维、功能迭代更新，
为MCSA提供全方位技术支持
text.en:
Build, develop and maintain MCSA’s online platforms, update event information and improve useful features to provide convenient online services.

Keep the website and mini program running reliably, improve features and resolve technical issues to create a better user experience.

Provide technical support through website and mini program development, ongoing maintenance and feature updates.

keywords.zh: 平台搭建｜程序开发｜技术学习｜技术保障
keywords.en: Platform building · Development · Learning · Technical support

description.zh: 负责 MCSA 网站的开发、维护与迭代，让功能更完善、体验更顺滑（全栈开发）。
description.en: Develop, maintain and improve the MCSA website through full-stack development, expanding its features and making it easier to use.

requirements.zh: 本科以上，在读IT、CS、arts（美术方向）和Design（视觉方向）专业优先录取
requirements.en: Undergraduate level or above; preference for students in IT, CS, fine arts or visual design

requirements.zh: 有基础编程能力或对编程有极大兴趣者优先录取
requirements.en: Basic programming skills or a strong interest in programming preferred

requirements.zh: 对全栈开发感兴趣的优先录取
良好的沟通与团队协作意识

description.zh: 负责 MCSA 微信小程序的开发与维护（功能开发、Bug 修复、上线迭代等）。
description.en: Develop and maintain the MCSA WeChat mini program, including new features, bug fixes and releases.

requirements.zh: 本科以上，在读IT、CS、arts（美术方向）和Design（视觉方向）专业优先录取
requirements.en: Undergraduate level or above; preference for students in IT, CS, fine arts or visual design

requirements.zh: 愿意投入时间学习并持续输出
requirements.en: Willingness to spend time learning and contribute consistently

requirements.zh: 良好的沟通与团队协作意识

learning.zh: 我们更看重学习能力、责任心与持续投入；不会也没关系，愿意学就行。
learning.en: We value your ability to learn, sense of responsibility and continued commitment. It is fine if you are new to this—as long as you are willing to learn.

application.zh:
原文报名时间：2026年7月24日–8月10日。
添加MCSA小助手，发送“秘书部”获取后续面试信息。
截止时间：墨尔本时间8月10日。每人最多报名两个部门。
以下二维码和招募名额来自已结束的招新轮次，不代表当前开放报名。
application.en:
Original application period: 24 July–10 August 2026.
Add an MCSA assistant on WeChat and send “秘书部” for interview information.
Deadline: 10 August, Melbourne time. Each person could apply to at most two departments.
The QR codes and recruitment places are from a past round and do not indicate that applications are currently open.
